verdict.rationale: Gusto hosts a live llms.txt at docs.gusto.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, confirmed by probe) plus .md-suffixed agent-friendly docs pages, and also documents a first-party MCP server for AI code editors to query its API/docs directly. This is exactly the agent-oriented docs discoverability the story asks for. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of agents actually consuming llms.txt in practice.
